```{r, echo=FALSE}
setwd("~/Desktop")
x <- read.csv("AdCollabData.csv", as.is = TRUE)

# load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
library(lme4)
library(MASS)
library(ggeffects)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Only keep nationally representative samples (YouGov, Lucid)
```{r}
x <- x %>% filter(study == "F"|study == "G"|study == "I"|study == "K"|study == "L"|study == "M"|study == "N"|study == "O"|study == "P"|study == "Q"|study == "R"|study == "S"|study == "T")

table(x$study)
```

## DemRep
```{r}
#x$demrep <- x$demreptemp #create temp variable 

#x$demrep <- x$demrepParty # 
#x$demrep <- x$demreptemp # JON - NEXT RUN ALL MODELS WITH THIS VARIABLE AS DEMREP
#x$demrep <- x$trump2016 # JON - NEXT RUN ALL MODELS WITH THIS VARIABLE AS DEMREP
#x$demrep <- x$demrep_c # STEVE WILL RUN MODELS WITH THIS VARIABLE
#x$demrep <- x$conservative # STEVE WILL RUN MODELS WITH THIS VARIABLE 

#for demrep_c only!
#x$demrep <- (1-0)/(6-1)*(x$demrep-6)+1

x$demrep <- 1-x$demrep

table(x$demrep)
```

Model #5: Evaluation
```{r}

#Subset, Just Evaluation
dataEvaluation <- subset(x, x$evaluation_treatment == 1 | x$control == 1)
xtabs(~dataEvaluation$evaluation_treatment)

#Check Which Studies Only Have Control Data
dataEvaluation %>% group_by(study) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(condition = mean(condition, na.rm = TRUE))

#Drop Study T 
dataEvaluation <- subset(dataEvaluation, dataEvaluation$study != "D" 
                     & dataEvaluation$study != "E"
                     & dataEvaluation$study != "F"
                     & dataEvaluation$study != "N"
                     & dataEvaluation$study != "O"
                     & dataEvaluation$study != "T")

model_lmer1 <- lmer(rating ~ headline_true*treated*demrep + (1+headline_true|study/id) + (1+treated*demrep|item_num), data=dataEvaluation, control = lmerControl(optimizer ="bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE))
summary(model_lmer1)
```

Model #6: Evaluation & Importance
```{r}

#Subset, Just Evaluation
dataEvaluationImportance <- subset(x, x$evaluation_treatment == 1 | x$control == 1 | x$importance_treatment == 1)

#Check Which Studies Only Have Control Data
dataEvaluationImportance %>% group_by(study) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(condition = mean(condition, na.rm = TRUE))

#Drop Studies
dataEvaluationImportance <- subset(dataEvaluationImportance, dataEvaluationImportance$study != "E"
                     & dataEvaluationImportance$study != "F"
                     & dataEvaluationImportance$study != "N"
                     & dataEvaluationImportance$study != "T")

model_lmer2 <- lmer(rating ~ headline_true*treated*demrep + (1+headline_true|study/id) + (1+treated*demrep|item_num), data=dataEvaluationImportance, control = lmerControl(optimizer ="bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE))
summary(model_lmer2)
```

## DemRep_c
```{r}
#x$demrep <- x$demreptemp #create temp variable 

#x$demrep <- x$demrepParty # 
#x$demrep <- x$demreptemp # JON - NEXT RUN ALL MODELS WITH THIS VARIABLE AS DEMREP
#x$demrep <- x$trump2016 # JON - NEXT RUN ALL MODELS WITH THIS VARIABLE AS DEMREP
x$demrep <- x$demrep_c # STEVE WILL RUN MODELS WITH THIS VARIABLE
#x$demrep <- x$conservative # STEVE WILL RUN MODELS WITH THIS VARIABLE 

#for demrep_c only!
x$demrep <- (1-0)/(6-1)*(x$demrep-6)+1

x$demrep <- 1-x$demrep

table(x$demrep)
```

Model #5: Evaluation
```{r}

#Subset, Just Evaluation
dataEvaluation <- subset(x, x$evaluation_treatment == 1 | x$control == 1)
xtabs(~dataEvaluation$evaluation_treatment)

#Check Which Studies Only Have Control Data
dataEvaluation %>% group_by(study) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(condition = mean(condition, na.rm = TRUE))

#Drop Study T 
dataEvaluation <- subset(dataEvaluation, dataEvaluation$study != "D" 
                     & dataEvaluation$study != "E"
                     & dataEvaluation$study != "F"
                     & dataEvaluation$study != "N"
                     & dataEvaluation$study != "O"
                     & dataEvaluation$study != "T")

model_lmer3 <- lmer(rating ~ headline_true*treated*demrep + (1+headline_true|study/id) + (1+treated*demrep|item_num), data=dataEvaluation, control = lmerControl(optimizer ="bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE))
summary(model_lmer3)
```
